lines.text: Don't let me get on the six-forty a.m. train.
lines.show: Don't let me get on the 6:40 a.m. train.

lines.text: [out of breath, urgent, low] Mira. You found me, didn't you? Tomorrow... don't let me get on the six-forty a.m. train.
lines.show: Mira. You found me, didn't you? Tomorrow... don't let me get on the 6:40 a.m. train.

lines.text: [voice breaking] Because if I do... you're the one who doesn't come home.
